窗台突出、离地 90 厘米
两条腿立在前后向平脚上

items.name_ja: パレットの積み重ね（白木）
items.desc_en: a stack of three identical plain wooden shipping pallets lying flat and squarely aligned, each 120 cm long, 80 cm wide and about 14 cm high, made of rough raw pale pine with five top deck boards, three bottom boards and three rows of square blocks between them, so the top deck stands 43 cm high, plain boards with no stamps, no marks and no text
items.keep_en: three aligned rough raw pale pine pallets stacked flat, five top deck boards, three rows of blocks, top surface 43 cm high, no stamps
checks: 三个托盘整齐叠放、顶面约 43 厘米

items.keep_en: smooth pale grey cast concrete with faint form marks smooth straight cylinder 40 cm across on a square base slab, flat round top 120 cm high, no fluting, no capital
